usedFor: Sangam CRM holds accounts, and SMS Manager by BulkSMS texts them when “Account Is Updated” runs “Send SMS”.

bestTemplate.name: “Account Is Updated” in Sangam CRM, then “Send SMS” in SMS Manager by BulkSMS
bestTemplate.why: An account change can notify the contact by text, sent through your SMS Manager by BulkSMS account.

watchOut: “Account Is Updated” is polling and fires on every update, so the same account can trigger a second text.
